title: 第1章 万兽衍策
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
金乌省，玄龟州。

    黑土县，青河乡。

    青河乡东头，有一座两进的院子。

    门外歪歪扭扭的挂着一块牌匾。

    【御兽蒙学】。

    今日是蒙学最后一堂课。

    孩子的眼睛齐刷刷盯着讲台上，胡师肩头那只通体银灰的蝴蝶。

    胡师微微一笑，轻抖手腕，【彩粉文蝶】便从他肩头振翅而起。

    翅膀一扇，细碎的荧粉便洒落在空中，凝成一行行端正的小楷。

    “伟力归神兽，神兽归仙朝。”

    在蒙学的最后一堂课...

    胡师还是选择了这大乾朝人人会念的一句话，作为开场白。

    因为...

    他认为...

    尽管这句话，墙根底下三岁的娃娃都能背出来。

    但真要说明白是什么意思，十个大人里头九个说不清。

    在确保，所有孩子的眸光都被吸引来了之后...

    胡师咳嗽一声，清了清嗓子：

    “你们马上要去考潜鳞书院了。

    在蒙学里，我教的东西粗浅，比不上书院先生的万一。

    但有些根底上的道理，你们这辈子都得记着。”

    他踱了两步，【彩粉文蝶】跟着飞到他身前。

    翅膀轻扇，荧粉变换，空中浮现出一只展翅金鸟的轮廓。

    虽然粗糙，却隐约带着一股灼热的气韵。

    胡师微微一笑，开口考校道：

    “这是什么？”

    前排几个孩子想都没想，便齐声喊：

    “【司晨金乌】！”

    胡师点点头，【彩粉文蝶】又扇翅，金鸟散去，换成一只巨龟伏卧的模样。

    挑了挑眉：

    “这个呢？”

    “【镇河龟】！”

    这回不止前排的孩子，连后排打盹的几个都跟着喊了。

    【镇河龟】他们熟，玄龟州嘛，年年祭河大典，谁家没去看过。

    胡师笑了一下，【彩粉文蝶】再扇，巨龟化开，变成一只垂天巨鹏的影子。

    荧粉翅展开来几乎遮了半间教室的天花板，几个胆小的孩子往后缩了缩。

    这一会，不等孩子们答复，胡师便自顾自的答道：

    “这个，是【镇风鹏】。”

    “掌四季之风，若它收翅不飞，全天下的风行灵舟都要停在港口。”

    荧粉一收，教室里重新暗下来，只剩【彩粉文蝶】翅上那点微光，安安静静地落回胡师肩头。

    胡师转过身，目光扫了一圈，慢悠悠道：

    “所以我问你们...”

    “大乾仙朝，立朝三千年不倒。

    天下万兽，不论是蛮力，权柄，还是说对天地的掌控....

    哪一样都远胜于人！

    【司晨金乌】一声长鸣，昼夜轮转。

    【镇河龟】翻个身，万里江河改道。

    【裂渊玄鲸】潜入深海镇压海眼。

    【镇岳天猿】立于群山稳定地脉...

    人族明明什么都不如他们...

    凭什么却能凌驾于这万兽之上？”

    教室里有一瞬间的寂静。

    胡师笑了笑。

    眸光扫过下方的一排排脸庞。

    从孩子的破烂衣服，到丢失了一只鞋的草鞋。

    心中微微叹气。

    这些孩子大多来自于附近的村子里，多数孩子的身上都有泥土的味道。

    他们的家里，只不过是图三百文的蒙学便宜，只求让他们认个字，知晓些御兽的常识...

    当爹当妈的都不指望他们出人头地，他们又怎会认真听讲？

    哪怕...

    这应该是他们今生唯一一次改变自己命运的机会……

    胡师的目光扫过每一个人，最后停在前排左侧第二个位置上。

    那里坐着一位眉清目秀的少年，腰板直挺。

    衣服并不是最好的布料，但是洗得一丝不苟，一点褶皱都没有。

    看得出，是家人精心帮他打理过的。

    管中窥豹，这起码比起他们的家人，多了几分认真。

    胡师轻启薄唇：

    “子诚。”

    “胡师，弟子在。”

    李子诚站了起来，恭敬道。

    胡师微微点头，一阵阵回忆浮现脑海。

    ‘李子诚。

    理论功底极其扎实。

    听说...这三年中，他县中开小卖铺的爹李虎，没少辅导他。

    他的爹早年考【县学】没考上，将全部的希望，都压在了他的身上...

    好在，李子诚，也没让他爹失望。

    在蒙学三年，回回考核，不是头名，也是第二...’

    李子诚一板一眼的拱了拱手，带着几分少年老成。

    沉稳道：

    “回先生的话。

    大乾仙朝，一切伟力归于神兽，神兽归于仙朝。

    官职掌神兽，神兽掌天地权柄。”

    “朝廷一声令下，在规定的时辰内，高悬于皇州之上的【司晨金乌】便得振翅巡天，为整个天下带来阳光！

    哪怕是边疆苦寒之地，只要圣旨一到，令金乌长鸣，那长夜也得乖乖退避！”

    “而到了规定的时辰，【司晨金乌】归巢，【巡月金蟾】便会接替其位，跃上夜幕，为天下人洒落月华，平息地脉的阴气！”

    “大乾十三省的四季之风，皆归巡风司的【镇风鹏】管辖。

    若是到了春耕秋种之际，天下何处要下雨，何处要降下灵霖灌溉，皆由司雨监的【司雨龙】所控！”

    他顿了顿，像是在心里理了理措辞，接着道：

    “再厉害的神兽，都得在大乾治下听令行事。

    而若要操控这些神兽，便得经县学、府学、省学，通过大考，获取功名，入朝为官。

    所以...”

    “官位即神权。做官，就是掌控天地的权柄。”

    李子诚抬起头，目光清亮。

    这话说得干净利落，几个孩子愣了愣，随即露出若有所思的表情。

    胡师微微颔首，嘴角带着笑意。

    这种学生教起来省心，但凡世道公平些，这孩子日后怎么都差不了。

    “非常好。”

    “罗影，你补充补充。”

    胡师转动一下眼睛，随意的说道。

    没有回应。

    教室右边靠近窗户的一个角落里，有一个少年伏在桌子上，把头藏到手臂里，均匀地呼吸着。

    相比李子诚起来...

    少年身上短褐、灰扑扑的，并还打上了两个补丁。

    肩膀上所覆盖的布料非常薄，以至于能隐约看到骨头。

    胡师朝那方向看了眼，眉头轻轻一皱，又迅速放松。

    他没有出声催促。

    教了三年书，胡师对罗影的情况太了解了。

    这孩子生来就非常聪明，反应很快、思维很活跃，一点就通。

    若要说谁能夺了李子诚的头名，那便只有他了。

    去年的摸底考核，罗影的兽理推演拿了第一，连御兽属性克制的变式题都答出来了！

    要知道...那道题压根就不是蒙学的水准！

    是他自己出着玩的！

    这足以见证罗影那变态的天份。

    罗影是蒙学里，和李子诚唯二的双子星，是胡师心中冲刺县学的天才。

    可这半年来，罗影上课却总是无精打采。

    胡师知道原因。

    罗家出事了。

    罗影的父亲罗长庚，原本是罗家村一个老实巴交的庄稼汉，家里养了一头【黑水牛】和两只【啄虫鸡】，靠那头牛犁地翻田，日子紧巴但还过得去。

    可去年开春，罗长庚在地里赶牛翻深土的时候闪了腰，伤了根骨，在床上躺了大半年，地里的活全压在了罗影大哥罗川身上。

    罗川大罗影十岁，今年二十四了，打小就跟着父亲下地。

    父亲伤了腰以后，犁地、播种、挑水、喂牛，里里外外全是他一个人撑着。

    村里人都说罗家大小子是条汉子，可汉子也是肉长的，胡师有一回在村口碰见罗川赶牛回来，才二十出头的后生，背已经有些微驼了。

    蒙学的束脩不贵，一年才三百文铜钱，村里但凡有口饭吃的人家都供得起。

    朝廷也乐意办蒙学，让孩子们认几个字，懂些御兽的基本常识，知道什么兽能养什么兽不能碰，往后在乡里做个本分的庄稼人，也好管。

    可县学不一样。

    潜鳞书院一年的学费是六两银子，整整翻了二十倍不止。

    这还只是束脩，不算兽粮、灵材、契约仪式的耗材。

    因为进了县学，学的就不再是纸面上的东西了。

    那是真真正正要开发人族潜能、学习契约术、走上御兽师之路、日后考取功名入朝为官的正途。

    正途意味着门槛。
content_en:
Jinwu Province, Xuangui Prefecture.
Heitu County, Qinghe Township.
At the east end of Qinghe Township, there is a courtyard with two entrances.
There is a plaque hanging crookedly outside the door.
【Beast Control Education】.
Today is the last class of elementary school.
The children's eyes were all staring at the silver-gray butterfly on Master Hu's shoulder on the podium.
Master Hu smiled slightly, flicked his wrist, and the [Colorful Pink Butterfly] fluttered from his shoulders.
When he flaps his wings, fine pieces of fluorescent powder fall into the air, condensing into rows of regular regular script.
"The great power belongs to the divine beasts, and the divine beasts belong to the immortal dynasty."
The last class in Mengxu...
Master Hu still chose this sentence that everyone in the Daqian Dynasty would read as his opening remarks.
because...
He thinks...
Although this sentence can be recited by a three-year-old baby under the wall.
But if you really want to understand what it means, nine out of ten adults can't explain it.
After making sure that all the children's eyes were attracted...
Master Hu coughed and cleared his throat:
"You are about to go to Qianlin Academy.
In elementary school, the things I taught were superficial and not as good as those taught by the academy teachers.
But there are some basic truths that you need to remember throughout your life."
He took two steps, and the [Colorful Pink Butterfly] flew in front of him.
The wings flap lightly, the fluorescent powder changes, and the outline of a golden bird with spread wings appears in the sky.
Although it is rough, it has a vaguely burning aura.
Master Hu smiled slightly and said:
"What's this?"
The children in the front row shouted in unison without even thinking:
"[Sichen Golden Crow]!"
Master Hu nodded, and the [Colorful Pink Butterfly] flapped its wings again, and the golden bird dispersed, replaced by a giant turtle lying down.
He raised his eyebrows:
"What about this?"
"[Zhenhe Turtle]!"
This time, not only the children in the front row, but also a few napping in the back row also shouted.
[Zhenhegui] They are familiar with each other. Xuangui Prefecture has a river ceremony every year. Who hasn’t been to it?
Master Hu smiled and fanned the [Colorful Pink Butterfly] again, and the giant turtle melted away and turned into the shadow of a huge roc hanging from the sky.
The pink wings spread out and almost covered half of the classroom ceiling, and a few timid children shrank back.
At this moment, without waiting for the children to reply, Master Hu answered by himself:
"This is [Zhenfeng Peng]."
"It controls the winds of the four seasons. If it folds its wings and does not fly, all the wind-moving spirit boats in the world will stop at the port."
As soon as the fluorescent powder was removed, the classroom became dark again, leaving only the glimmer of light on the wings of the [Colorful Pink Butterfly], which quietly fell back on Master Hu's shoulder.
Master Hu turned around, glanced around, and said slowly:
"So I ask you..."
"The Daqian Immortal Dynasty will last for three thousand years.
All the beasts in the world, whether it is brute force, authority, or control over the heaven and earth...
Everything is far better than humans!
[Sichen Golden Crow] A long cry, day and night rotate.
[Zhenhe Turtle] Turn over and change the course of thousands of miles of rivers.
[Abyss Black Whale] Dive into the deep sea to suppress the eyes of the sea.
[Zhenyue Tianyuan] Standing on the stable ground of the mountains...
The human race is obviously inferior to them in everything...
Why can he be superior to all these beasts?"
There was a moment of silence in the classroom.
Master Hu smiled.
His eyes scanned the rows of faces below.
From a child's tattered clothes to a straw sandal with one shoe missing.
I sighed slightly in my heart.
Most of these children come from nearby villages, and most of them smell of earth.
Their home is nothing more than a simple education with three hundred texts, just to make them recognize the characters and know some common sense about beast control...
Parents don't expect them to get ahead, so how can they listen carefully?
Even if...
This should be their only chance to change their destiny...
Master Hu's eyes swept over everyone, and finally stopped at the second seat from the left in the front row.
Sitting there was a handsome young man with a straight back.
The clothes were not made of the best fabric, but they were washed meticulously and there were no wrinkles at all.
It can be seen that his family has carefully taken care of it for him.
You can catch a glimpse of the leopard through the tube, this is at least a little more serious than their family members.
Master Hu lightly opened his thin lips:
"Zicheng."
"Master Hu, the disciple is here."
Li Zicheng stood up and said respectfully.
Master Hu nodded slightly, and memories came to mind.
‘Li Zicheng.
The theoretical foundation is extremely solid.
I heard... In the past three years, his father Li Hu, who owns a small shop in the county, has been tutoring him.
His father failed to pass the [County School] exam in his early years, so he put all his hopes on him...
Fortunately, Li Zicheng did not disappoint his father.
After three years of elementary school, I came in second place in every assessment...'
Li Zicheng bowed his hand sternly, with a hint of youthfulness.
He said calmly:
"Reply sir.
In the Daqian Immortal Dynasty, all great power belongs to the divine beasts, and the divine beasts belong to the Immortal Dynasty.
The official position controls the divine beast, and the divine beast controls the power of heaven and earth."
"With an order from the imperial court, within the specified time, the [Sichen Golden Crow] hanging high above the imperial state will flap its wings and patrol the sky, bringing sunshine to the entire world!
Even if it is a bitter cold place on the frontier, as soon as the imperial edict arrives and the golden crow crows, the long night must be retreated obediently!"
"And when the prescribed time comes, the [Sichen Golden Crow] returns to its nest, and the [Moon Patrolling Golden Toad] will take over its place, leap into the night, shed moonlight for the people of the world, and calm the yin energy in the earth's veins!"
“The winds of the four seasons in the thirteen provinces of Daqian are all under the jurisdiction of the [Zhenfengpeng] of the Wind Patrol Department.
If it is time for spring plowing and autumn planting, wherever it will rain and where it will be irrigated, it will all be controlled by [Si Yulong] of the Si Yu Supervisor!"
He paused, as if sorting out his words in his mind, and then continued:
“No matter how powerful the beast is, it must obey orders under the rule of Da Gan.
If you want to control these mythical beasts, you have to go to county schools, government schools, and provincial schools, pass major exams, gain fame, and become an official in the court.
so..."
"Official position is divine power. Being an official is the authority to control heaven and earth."
Li Zicheng raised his head, his eyes clear.
This was said cleanly and neatly, and several children were stunned for a moment, then showed thoughtful expressions.
Master Hu nodded slightly, with a smile on his lips.
It is easy to teach this kind of student, but if the world is fairer, this child will never be bad in the future.
"very good."
"Luo Ying, please add more."
Master Hu rolled his eyes and said casually.
No response.
In a corner on the right side of the classroom near the window, there was a young man leaning on the table, hiding his head in his arms, breathing evenly.
Compared to Li Zicheng...
The boy's body was short brown, gray, and had two patches.
The cloth covering the shoulders is so thin that the bones can be faintly seen.
Master Hu glanced in that direction, frowned slightly, and then relaxed quickly.
He made no sound to urge.
After teaching for three years, Master Hu knew Luo Ying's situation very well.
This child is born very smart, reacts quickly, thinks very actively, and knows everything.
If anyone can take the top spot from Li Zicheng, it would be him.
In last year's basic assessment, Luo Ying took first place in animal reasoning, and even answered the variant questions on beast-controlling attributes!
You know...that question is not at the elementary level!
He did it for fun!
This is enough to witness Luo Ying's perverted talent.
Luo Ying is the only twin star in Meng Xue and Li Zicheng. He is the genius in Master Hu's heart who wants to compete in county school.
But in the past six months, Luo Ying has always been listless in class.
Master Hu knew the reason.
Something happened to the Luo family.
Luo Ying's father, Luo Changgeng, was originally an honest farmer in Luojia Village. The family raised a "black buffalo" and two "insect-pecking chickens". They relied on the cow to plow the fields, and their life was tight but still manageable.
But in the spring of last year, Luo Changgeng slipped while driving cattle in the fields and broke a bone. He lay in bed for more than half a year. All the work in the fields fell on Luo Ying's eldest brother Luo Chuan.
Luo Chuan Da Luo Ying is ten years old, twenty-four this year. He has followed his father to the fields since he was a child.
After my father injured his back, he plowed the fields, planted seeds, carried water, and fed the cattle, all by himself.
People in the village said that the eldest son of the Luo family was a man, but men are also fat. Master Hu once met Luo Chuan at the entrance of the village as he was driving cattle. He was only in his early twenties and his back was already slightly hunched.
Meng Xue's education was not expensive, only three hundred copper coins a year, and anyone in the village who had food to eat could afford it.
The imperial court is also willing to run elementary schools so that the children can recognize a few words, understand some basic knowledge of animal control, know which animals can be raised and which animals cannot be touched, so that they can be responsible farmers in the countryside and be easy to manage.
But the county school is different.
The annual tuition fee of Qianlin Academy is six taels of silver, which is more than twenty times higher.
This is just for cultivating, not counting animal food, spiritual materials, and consumables for the contract ceremony.
Because after entering the county school, what I learned was no longer just something on paper.
That is the true path to develop the human potential, learn the contract technique, embark on the path of a beast master, and later obtain fame and become an official in the court.
The right path means the threshold.
title_en: Chapter 1 The Strategy of Ten Thousand Beasts
